checks.name: M5 additive migration replays, verifies RLS and least-privilege metadata
disabled quota triggers and modified privileged function bodies fail startup verification
quota CHECK and ownership foreign-key drift are detected despite an unchanged ledger
platform console and metadata require the platform Host and persisted operator
manual plan updates require current version and cannot go below usage
concurrent native product inserts cannot exceed the tenant quota
soft deletion frees capacity and native restoration is also quota checked
concurrent byte reservations charge ready files without exceeding upload caps
file deletion frees bytes and failed disk writes retain accurate accounting
pre-pause checkout can be prepared without acquiring a paid order
pause blocks new checkout, product writes and collection while sibling shop remains active
paused native owner authentication and audit work without accepting sibling identities
paid order fulfillment and shipment remain available while paused
pending refunds remain recoverable after pause and process restart
signed paused callbacks reconcile existing orders but cannot create a new order
paused cancellation refunds a captured order and releases inventory
tenant and authentication rate windows are atomic and do not accept forwarding bypasses
tenant audits are append only, redact bodies and include server-generated request IDs
health separates API, DB and worker, and stale heartbeat fails readiness
fair dispatch services another tenant before draining a noisy tenant
unknown non-event job kinds do not acquire fallback handlers
paused ordinary jobs defer without losing their retry budget
queue caps reserve capacity for verified payment events
backup maintenance gate blocks writes and workers while reads stay available
client disconnect keeps the backup fence until the actual platform mutation settles
bounded maintenance clears expired state while preserving uncertain payment recovery
large expired cache and lock collections are reclaimed in bounded tenant-only batches
platform monitoring returns queue alerts without customer or financial data
